{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Number of duplicate patient_id values:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check distribution of arm and severity
df_cross = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'])
print("Cross-tab of arm vs severity:")
print(df_cross)

# Summary of biomarker_baseline
print("\nSummary of biomarker_baseline:")
print(df['biomarker_baseline'].describe())"}
